data.summary: An accomplished professional; offering nearly 7 years of comprehensive experience in Software Development, specializing in Core Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and modern backend technologies, with a proven track record of delivering robust and scalable solutions across multiple industries.

responsibilities: Actively involved in design creation to drive technical solutions.
Managing a backend team of five engineers, ensuring effective collaboration and productivity.
Ensuring strict adherence to Agile methodologies and alignment with delivery timelines.
Implemented features like quick reviews for that made integration with google AMP.
Implemented data pipelines using Spark, Airflow DAG.
Implemented GraphQL APIs to fetch required data for clients.
Implemented RabbitMQ Messaging flow for Monetization mechanism.
Implemented parent-pom mechanism for managing dependencies centrally.
Actively involved in design discussions, code reviews, bug fixing, and implementing unit and integration testing.
Given demo of microservices architecture implementation and its benefits.
Implemented excel report generation using Apache poi.
Implemented centralized logging system using ELK stack
Extensively worked in designing/developing in web application for CITI Bank for managing custody reporting.
Designed and developed 4 microservices for report migration and scheduling part of report.
Implemented AG-Grid server-side Implementation of functionalities such as sorting, filtering, pagination.
Implemented excel and csv report generation functionality using jasper report technology.
Given POC to client to reduce API response time by 100 times and implemented caching mechanism for storing entitlement information on server side.
Involved in integration testing with front-end team, bug fixing session, support to QA team and given demo to client after every sprint.
To make fault tolerant code implement unit test cases using mockito framework, done with rigorous local testing and integration testing as well.
Extensively worked in designing/developing in web application for Finish Client for their pension and insurance project.
Implemented Spring batches for processing chunk of data.
Involved in deployment activities.

certifications.name: Pro Degree Certification in Data Science and Machine Learning

projects.name: Unified Reporting for Custody Reporting
projects.description: Developed a stable web application for Citi Bank to streamline custody reporting. Contributed to building the landing page for report execution and scheduling.

projects.name: Pension and Insurance Web Application
projects.description: Client required stable web enterprise for their internal employees to manage the process of pension and insurance. We created a stable web application in which I have developed some new modules and added some functionalities to existing modules.
